subject: Type II delivery window, bridge letter and procurement gating items
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@aurelia-sys.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@aurelia-sys.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Type II delivery window, bridge letter and procurement gating items

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for taking the call last week. Per our discussion about Aurelia's upcoming renewal and expansion, attaching the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) and a draft bridge-letter template we can sign to cover the gap until your renewal effective date.

Quick summary:
- SOC 2 Type II report covers the period 2023-08-01 through 2024-07-31 (auditor: Clearpath Audit LLP).
- We can provide a signed bridge letter that affirms controls are maintained post-reporting period and will cover Aurelia's renewal date (we suggested 2025-11-30 during the call).
- Procurement gating: please confirm whether you need the full unredacted report or a redacted version + auditor attestation (many customers accept redacted reports + bridge). I attached a one-page procurement checklist that typically satisfies finance/legal.

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_2024_redacted.pdf (pdf), Bridge_Letter_Draft.docx (docx), procurement-checklist.xlsx (xlsx).

Would you be able to confirm by end of next week whether the redacted report + bridge is sufficient and the PO timeline for the expansion seats? If you need an NDA or additional artifacts (pen-test summary, data-retention policy), we can surface those from the compliance folder.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0198

[Attachment: SOC2_TypeII_2024_redacted.pdf] [Attachment: Bridge_Letter_Draft.docx] [Attachment: procurement-checklist.xlsx]

From: Emma Li <emma.li@aurelia-sys.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@aurelia-sys.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 11:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Type II delivery window, bridge letter and procurement gating items

Hi Aditya —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the files. A few clarifying questions from procurement/legal:

1) Can you confirm the exact audit period covered by the attached Type II? We need the begin/end dates for our compliance team.
2) Will the bridge letter be signed by someone in our contract (i.e., on Redwood letterhead with a dated signature)? We need the bridge to explicitly state the coverage window (to our renewal date).
3) Is the auditor contact available if our third-party risk team wants to validate the report?
4) Do you have a one-page attestation (auditor or CISO) we can send to finance to avoid an SOW delay?

Procurement is also asking whether the unredacted report will be available under an NDA — can you loop legal if that's required?

If we can get the redacted report + a signed bridge letter + one-page attestation by the end of the month, we should be able to proceed with PO issuance in early October.

Thanks,
Emma
Senior Procurement Manager — Aurelia Systems
emma.li@aurelia-sys.com

---

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Type II delivery window, bridge letter and procurement gating items (internal)

Aditya — quick internal notes before you send final to Aurelia: 

- Legal prefers we provide the redacted Type II + a company-signed bridge letter (on letterhead, dated) stating controls remain in place and covering up to agreed renewal date. Drafting suggestion: cover through 2025-11-30 unless Aurelia asks for a different date.
- Compliance can also provide a one-page attestation signed by our Head of Security (I can get Evelyn to sign). That usually satisfies finance teams quickly.
- If procurement requests the unredacted report, we'll require an NDA and evidence of intended use; have legal prepare the NDA template.
- Attach procurement-checklist.xlsx (stub) to the response and call out the minimal gating items: redacted report, bridge letter, attestation, PO/PO number, billing contact, and signed SOW.

I'll draft the bridge letter and one-page attestation — Aditya, once you confirm the renewal date with Emma, I'll finalize and have Evelyn sign.

-Lauren
VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: procurement-checklist.xlsx]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@aurelia-sys.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@aurelia-sys.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Type II delivery window, bridge letter and procurement gating items

Emma —

Thanks for the questions. Per Compliance: the SOC 2 Type II covers 2023-08-01 through 2024-07-31 (auditor: Clearpath Audit LLP). We are attaching the redacted PDF and a signed bridge letter that affirms controls remain effective and provides coverage through 2025-11-30. Also attaching a one-page attestation signed by our Head of Security.

Attachments included: SOC2_TypeII_2024_redacted.pdf (pdf), Bridge_Letter_Nov2025.pdf (pdf, signed), Attestation_1page_EvelynHart.pdf (pdf), procurement-checklist.xlsx (xlsx).

We can provide the unredacted report under NDA if procurement/legal prefers — happy to loop legal. Auditor contact: Claire Mendes, Clearpath Audit LLP, claire.mendes@clearpathaudit.com (they have supported validations for customers previously).

Next steps we'd suggest:
- Please confirm the bridge coverage acceptance and whether the redacted package + attestation satisfies your finance/legal gating.
- If yes, confirm PO timeline and PO number if already issued (or target issue date).
- If you need the unredacted report, reply-all and we'll have Legal send NDA template within 24 hours.

If you can confirm by EOB Monday, 29 Sep, we should hit the expansion onboarding target in mid-November.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0198

[Attachment: SOC2_TypeII_2024_redacted.pdf] [Attachment: Bridge_Letter_Nov2025.pdf] [Attachment: Attestation_1page_EvelynHart.pdf] [Attachment: procurement-checklist.xlsx]
